mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.1 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers preemptive monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1100.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 103.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signals persistent inflation and a tightening monetary policy regime, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE below 5.0% and rise in PAYEMS above 145,000 thousand signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting aggressive Fed response and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 145000, or the joint signal effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 450,000 million dollars combined with rising HOUST above 1,100 thousand units signals strong household demand and housing market strength, which fuels inflation and triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS > 450000 and HOUST > 1100.0, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 104.0 combined with a drop in GDPC1 below 16,500 billion dollars signals a weakening real economy and contraction in output, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 104.0 and GDPC1 < 16500, or the joint signal is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction model).
